history_summary: Record generic genus correspondences and cyanobacterial alternatives for the FBCC-A233 culture.
history_details: The exact pinned crosswalk adds the Sphingorhabdus_B genus correspondence with 27 of 27 reference genomes and Brevundimonas with 221 of 221. These filtered reference populations are not study-stock genome assignments, culture abundance or a complete culture census. The Sphingorhabdus_B name-difference flag and non-type-clade warning are retained in the bound native source proof; the writer serializes the reclassification flag but does not add the warning to the canonical block or native log. The generic Dolichospermum species-name route retains all three ordered native alternatives and AMBIGUOUS status without a single classification block or inferred denominator. That generic result does not replace or dispute the paper's separate GTDB-Tk v2.5.2/r226 placement of the recovered FBCC-A233 genome in the flosaquae cluster; its existing canonical note and stock designation remain unchanged. The pinned crosswalk's release and chronology are not established by its modification date. Only two reference blocks, three statuses, the complete ambiguity list and two native inline events changed. All source quotations, absent associate-stock fields, abundance and stability annotations, culture settings, two computational cofactor nodes, PARTIAL evidence, absence of arrows and prior history are preserved. Issues 1406, 2691, 2692 and 2693 remain unresolved by this technical correspondence correction, including source-genome provenance, maintenance interpretation and unconfirmed cofactor exchange. This partial diagnostic does not complete scientific review, generated products or aggregate QC.
